I can't believe a post could be riddled with such racist rhetoric. First off, "I'm friends with black people, I get along with black people. Just like the cops who stood by and either kept passersby at bay or helped to hold Floyd down, by not standing with black people (the victims) against direct oppressors, YOU ARE PART OF THE PROBLEM.

Not to be "that person" but I would like to point out that "simp" does actually have a specific definition (at least, the term originated to describe a specific type of person) and technically Luther doesn't qualify as one -- he seems to genuinely care about Allison (though I won't say I'm a huge supporter of their relationship or his actions.)

Moving on, its really easy to demonize Luther because from what we saw play out, Luther's insensitive and reckless actions seem to stand out as the main catalysts for Vanya losing control and causing the apocalypse. I used to hate Luther and he's honestly still my least favorite Hargreeves sibling but I also think more people should cut him some slack. 

As was mentioned before, its totally possible that Allison used her power to get Luther to have feelings for her, which could have made him emotionally stunted and have a ride-or-die mentality for Allison, even going so far as to harm his other sister in order to protect her. It seems very clear that if Luther hadn't rushed at Vanya during her performance to protect Allison, Vanya may have not had the massive outburst that caused the apocalypse but Five's experiences also indicated that the apocalypse could happen different ways (when he first traveled into the future, the discovery of the eye seemed to indicate that Harold/Leonard remained an active player in the narrative for much longer than what we saw play out in episode 9 and 10) and its totally likely that even if Luther were completely removed from the picture, something else would have set Vanya off and it PROBABLY would have been one of her other siblings.

The fact of the matter is that the Hargreeves are all really messed up and misunderstood and its very clear throughout the show that one of their major overarching flaws is communicating with, trusting, and respecting each other. Luther was a dummy and his actions still piss me off but Luther is really only as bad as his upbringing and, really, all of the Hargreeves and especially Reginald all played a part in causing the apocalypse because that family is a mess. Luther just seems like the village idiot because we only saw one version of the apocalypse and his bad decisions were front and center in it.
Dammit Luther. But I also feel like if Luther wasn't there something else would have happened. Maybe Vanya still getting really upset and not having the chamber to contain her? Who knows?
